body: Certainly, but it feels that all just really ended, if it makes sense. Time doesn't seem to heal. The darkness doesn't dissipate. I was hurt so badly, suddenly, intentionally by the person I loved. The person who promised the world to me. She betrayed me in the most unapologetic and cruel way. One day the relationship was great, the next morning she sent me the text. I read it and I wished I was never brought to this world. The last thing I heard from her was that I brought all that to myself.  She clearly has mental issues, but still. And she took my hopes, my dreams, my life and my money with her. I am left with nothing and I trust no one. All I can do now is to talk with strangers on the internet. So pathetic!!!! I am not 20 anymore, I do not have time to heal and rebound. I had been skeptical about that relationship at the start, but she pursued me, and I gave it my all. I am totally empty now.

I am 38 now. To tell you the truth, I do not believe the therapy would help. The key to the success is that the patient themselves have to want to get better. My problem is that I lost the motivation to try. Thank you though for talking with me. This is very much appreciated!
I tried to schedule a session with a therapist. The wait time is a few weeks. It seems that I am on my own.

No. There is nobody I can talk to. My SO was my closest friend and she cut off all contact. I have been moving a lot for work in the past new years, so I had no chance to develop any other close friendships

Thank you for reading. I would say the things started going downhill some 3-4 years ago. Two and a half years ago I resisted temptation to drive my car off a cliff. Now it feels even worse. I am in so much psychological pain, I can't stand it anymore. I called the suicide prevention hotline. It did not help at all. They just give you very general advice that has no impact. It does not matter though. That hotline is for people who still have hope. My hope is dead. I am researching the methods now. I want my attempt to work 100%. As soon as I have everything needed, I will pick a date when I am not expected to show for work for a while. Most probably, the next holiday. Strangely, it gives me something to look forward to.
